abstract: PURPOSE: To determine the feasibility and usefulness of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for evaluating cardiovascular invasion of a thoracic mass by demonstrating the sliding motion between the mass and adjacent structures. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Twenty-six patients (17 males and nine females, mean age = 49 years) were included in this study. They all had thoracic masses with equivocal cardiovascular invasion on chest CT scan and/or MRI that were surgically confirmed. The pathologic diagnoses were teratoma/thymic tumor (N = 12), lung cancer (N = 9), and other thoracic tumor (N = 5). Conventional T1/T2, contrast-enhanced, and breathheld ECG-gated cine MRI using a steady-state free precession (SSFP) technique was performed. The results were compared to the surgical reports. RESULTS: The cine MR images showed the presence of sliding motion in 39 structures in 20 patients, which were surgically confirmed as not being invaded, and 15 structures in six patients with the absence of sliding motion noted as tumor invasion. Therefore, the accuracy of the cine MR images was 94.4% (51/54) for evaluating cardiovascular invasion of a thoracic mass. CONCLUSION: MRI can provide additional information and improve the accuracy of preoperative staging for predicting cardiovascular invasion of a thoracic mass by evaluating the sliding motion.
abstract_ja:
目的：胸部腫瘤と隣接構造の間のすべり運動を示すことにより、胸部腫瘤の心血管浸潤を評価するMRIの実現可能性と有用性を明らかにすること。
材料と方法：胸部CTおよび/またはMRIで心血管浸潤が疑われ、手術で確定診断された胸部腫瘤の患者26例（男性17例、女性9例、平均年齢49歳）を対象とした。病理診断は奇形腫/胸腺腫瘍（12例）、肺癌（9例）、その他の胸部腫瘍（5例）であった。従来のT1/T2強調像、造影MRI、ならびに定常状態自由歳差運動（SSFP）法による呼吸停止心電図同期シネMRIを施行した。結果は手術所見と比較した。
結果：シネMR像では、20例の39構造においてすべり運動が認められ、手術により非浸潤と確認された。6例の15構造ではすべり運動が認められず、腫瘍浸潤と判定された。したがって、胸部腫瘤の心血管浸潤評価の正確度は94.4%（51/54）であった。
結論：MRIは追加情報を提供しうるとともに、すべり運動の評価により胸部腫瘤の心血管浸潤を予測する術前病期分類の正確度を向上させることができる。
